mapper.select: SELECT w.id, w.cover_storage_provider AS storageProvider, w.cover_bucket AS bucket, w.cover_object_key AS objectKey, w.cover_mime_type AS mimeType, w.cover_size_bytes AS sizeBytes FROM entitlements e JOIN wallpapers w ON w.id = e.wallpaper_id WHERE e.user_id = #{userId} AND w.id = #{id} AND w.cover_status = 'READY' AND w.cover_object_key IS NOT NULL
